name: Lord Amber's Bodyguard
backstory: Lord Amber's Bodyguard is a half-elven monk who accompanies his master to the ceremony of ordaining Enver Gortash as an Archduke of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.
voice_hint: half-elf monk (voiced by Leemore Marrett Jr.)
